title: Dog Nutrition and Feeding Guide
content: Dogs require balanced nutrition with proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins and minerals. Puppies need high-protein diets (22-32% protein) for growth. Adult dogs need 18-25% protein. Feed twice daily for adults, three times for puppies. Always provide fresh water.

title: Common Dog Health Issues and Prevention
content: Dogs should receive regular vaccinations including rabies, DHPP (distemper, hepatitis, parvovirus, parainfluenza). Annual check-ups recommended. Common issues: ear infections, dental disease, obesity. Maintain healthy weight through proper diet and exercise.

title: Dog Medication Safety
content: Always store medications in original labeled containers. Never give human medications to dogs. Common safe medications: amoxicillin, aspirin (with vet approval). Toxic: acetaminophen, ibuprofen, chocolate, grapes, onions. If accidental exposure, contact vet immediately.

title: Cat Nutrition and Diet
content: Cats are obligate carnivores needing high-quality protein (30%+ for adults). Kittens need 30-40% protein. Feed 2-3 times daily for kittens, once daily for adults. Ensure adequate taurine intake (essential amino acid). Wet food helps maintain hydration.

title: Cat Health and Wellness
content: Cats need FVRCP vaccine (feline viral rhinotracheitis, calicivirus, panleukopenia) and rabies. Dental care crucial - brush teeth regularly. Monitor litter box habits (changes indicate illness). Annual exams recommended. Spay/neuter recommended.

title: Rabbit Care and Nutrition
content: Rabbits need unlimited timothy hay (80% of diet), fresh vegetables (leafy greens), and limited pellets. Provide 1 cup pellets per 5 lbs body weight daily. Fresh water essential. Avoid: iceberg lettuce, beans, grains. Hay keeps teeth healthy and aids digestion.

title: Rabbit Health and Habitat
content: Rabbits need spacious enclosures (minimum 4x2 feet), good ventilation, and cool temperatures (60-70°F). Provide hiding spots and enrichment. Avoid: heat, humidity, loud noises. Regular health checks for snuffles (respiratory), overgrown teeth, and ear mites.

title: Bird Nutrition and Diet
content: Birds need varied diet: high-quality pellets (60%), fresh fruits/vegetables (30%), seeds/nuts (10%). Avoid: avocado, chocolate, salt, caffeine. Different species need different nutrition (parrots: nuts and seeds; canaries: millet). Fresh water daily. Calcium important for egg-laying females.

title: Bird Behavior and Habitat
content: Birds need spacious cages (larger is better), natural light, and social interaction. Provide perches, toys, and foraging opportunities. Temperature 65-75°F optimal. Avoid drafts and smoke. Vocal birds can be loud in early morning/evening. Regular vet check-ups for respiratory health.

title: Horse Nutrition and Feeding
content: Horses need unlimited hay/pasture (1.5-2.5% body weight daily), supplemented with grain/concentrates based on activity level. Working horses need more calories. Fresh water essential (5-10 gallons daily). Minerals and vitamins important. Feeding schedule should be consistent.

title: Horse Health and Veterinary Care
content: Horses need annual vaccines (EWT: equine herpesvirus, influenza; tetanus booster annually). Dental care essential - float teeth annually. Hoof care every 6-8 weeks. Regular exercise maintains health. Watch for lameness, weight changes, lethargy. Colic is emergency - call vet immediately.
